description:
Faction Status v1.0.0

Description:

Faction Status is a lightweight quality-of-life mod. It dynamically modifies faction display names to include the player's current numerical relation and exact status level when hovering over planets, markets, or star systems on the map.

Features:

* Dynamically appends current player relations (e.g.,

+100

,

-65

) directly to faction display names in market and sector tooltips.

* Shows the exact relationship status level (e.g., Hostile, Neutral, Cooperative) pulled straight from the game engine.

* Updates in real-time as your reputation with factions changes.

Download:

Download Faction Status v1.0.0

Source Code:

GitHub Repository

Compatibility:

* Starsector 0.98a-RC8

* Compatible with existing save games.

* Safe to add or remove at any time.
